implementation_actions.final_specification: Retain three-ball display and selected-generation data; add first-selection marker, disallow picking it twice, collect the second choice, show both names before final confirmation. B during second selection returns to first; declining final pair does not create Pokémon. Only final confirmation hands valid distinct indices to the grant routine.

Build both level5 Pokémon in temporary structs, apply exact opening presets, validate two free party slots, and commit both with the two choice values and opening state1 in one non-yielding operation. No successful partial grant, no PC fallback during fresh rescue, no silent party overwrite. State1 re-entry reuses existing Pokémon.

Replace only the Hoenn Birch first-battle enemy construction with the exact two prepared rescue foes. Set FIRST_BATTLE|DOUBLE in CB2_StartFirstBattle; no TRAINER or MULTI flag. Both player starters and both foes occupy genuine active slots.

Use the shared expert doubles evaluator for the Hoenn rescue. Remove its automatic low-player-HP flee behavior; leave FRLG/Oak and unrelated wild AI paths scoped away. Do not use opponent trainer metadata for this scripted wild pair.

Extend the existing restart snapshot to the scoped Birch-rescue predicate. Restore both player Pokémon exactly, rebuild the fixed rescue enemy pair instead of trainer parties, then reinitialize. No gift/grant code is called on Retry. Declining Retry returns to pair preparation or the pending bag scene without marking rescue success.

Move FLAG_RESCUED_BIRCH and success hide/warp writes after an actual victory. Losing no longer falls through into success dialogue. The bag and both wild actors remain tied to the pending rescue state until success.

Acknowledge and optionally nickname both already-owned starters, then set the OLD VAR_BIRCH_LAB_STATE to3 before any supplies failure can release script control. The NEW VAR_EC_OPENING_STATE remains2 until Dex plus20PokéBalls are delivered. Put a new-state5 legacy-supplement branch and then a new-state2 pending-supplies branch before ordinary Birch/aide dialogue; the always-present lab aide must serve the supplement while Birch is doing fieldwork. Both NPCs use the same handler and receipt state. Dispatch priority is owedlegacysecondstarter(state5), earlysupplies(state2), then the forms volume optional ResearchPartners menu, then ordinary dialogue so the player can exit, free storage and resume without the old lab-state2 OnFrame event retriggering. Route103 requires new opening state3. Retain post-win old lab-state4→5 story handoff as a debrief without duplicate gifts.

implementation_actions.final_specification: Retain the already-present unrestricted held-item vendor and full move/nature/Stat Point services. Verify first nurse visit gives Leveler and recovery tools before Route103. Add pre-rival PokéBall replenishment at Birch/Oldale with no story bypass; permit preparation/capture on accessible Route101/102/103 grass before accepting the rival challenge.

Compute unchosen=3−first−second after validating indices. Route103 slot0 uses the exact27-species final opening presets; all later branches preserve their authored starter stage and replace only the tagged starter slot. Use format-doubles choices and coherent noncolliding held items. Never apply the obsolete(first+1)%3 formula after pair initialization.

Use a shared branch-selector special returning(unchosen+2)%3 and existing historical aliases; convert six calls to trainerbattle_no_intro_double with the standard two-usable-mon message. Apply the same selector to Route104, RustboroCity, Route110, Route119 and Lilycove rival dispatch so reserve variants follow the rival line.

Treat both immutable initial species as excluded from paid starter prizes, independent of current party or evolved/released state. The unchosen third remains available through the archive under its ordinary gate. Existing per-species claim flags remain authoritative for other gifts.

Deliver stable slot0/1 stones for the first starter and slot2/3 for the second; reuse delivery bits0/1 and add bits2/3 in the existing16-bit variable. Preserve Bag/PC/held ownership checks and permanent receipts. Update Steven's script to iterate all four receipt slots without hiding him while anything is pending. Second-family slots become owed only after actual successful second-Pokémon delivery, never merely because the encoded choice exists in legacy state5. At v4 migration completion and successful supplemental gift commit, reconcile entitlements: if Steven previously completed the letter/Ring/badge2 handoff and any populated newly-earned second-family slot lacks a receipt, clear only FLAG_HIDE_GRANITE_CAVE_STEVEN. Route his return directly to pending starter-stone delivery before old departure handling; no repeated letter, Ring, old first-family gifts or rewards. Preserve all existing receipts and story flags. Empty or fulfilled slots never wake him.

Advance save version3→4 using the existing version discriminator. Retire declaration-only nursery names0x40E1/E2, zero their historical values before interpreting the new layout, and preserve all existing v1/v2/v3 migrations. Run the new migration before the old version3 early-return path. For old lab states2/3/4, process pending legacysecondgift before acknowledging both partners; set oldlab3 to suppress original OnFrame events while waiting. After successful supplement insertion, set newopeningstate2, not3, and run/resume the shared earlyDex+20Ball transaction. Only after supplies succeed set newstate3; if FLAG_DEFEATED_RIVAL_ROUTE103 is already set, then queue oldlab4debrief, otherwise leaveoldlab3. Only oldlab5 plus an existing Dexreceipt can move directly to newstate4. Preserve rival/story flags and all unrelated data through failures.
